단순 변심은 고객(customer), 불량·오배송은 사업자(seller): Change of mind: customer pays. Defect or wrong item: seller pays.
답변을 저장하면 상태가 '답변완료'로 바뀝니다. 비밀 문의는 작성자와 관: Saving a reply sets the status to 'Answered'. Private inquiries are visible only to the author and admins.
도서·농수산물 등 부가세가 없는 상품. 현금영수증·세금계산서 금액 계산에: VAT-exempt items such as books and fresh produce. Reflected in cash receipt and tax invoice amounts.

발급 처리할 때 반드시 입력하세요 — 없으면 국세청 자료와 대조할 수 없: Required when marking as issued — without it the record can't be matched against NTS data.
배송비와 입금 계좌를 정합니다. 무통장입금을 쓰면 계좌를 반드시 채워주세: Set shipping fees and the bank account. If you accept bank transfers, fill in the account — if it is empty, the order-complete screen shows nowhere to pay.
부가가치세법 제32조의2 — 손님이 요청하면 발급해야 하고, 미발급은 미: Korean VAT Act Article 32-2 — issuance is mandatory on request; failure carries a 20% penalty on the unissued amount. Card payments are excluded (the card company reports them to the NTS automatically; issuing again would double-report). 'Pending' means not yet reported to the NTS — issue it on Hometax, then enter the approval number.

상세 화면에서 갤러리로 보여집니다. 대표 이미지를 비우면 첫 장이 대표가: Shown as a gallery on the detail page. If the main image is empty, the first one becomes the main image.
상태를 '처리완료'로 바꾸는 순간 재고가 복원되고 환불이 실행됩니다. 반: The moment you set 'Completed', stock is restored and the refund executes. For returns and exchanges, complete only after the item arrives ('Received') — completing earlier just sends the money out. A reason is required when rejecting.
One product slug per line, in display order. Up to 200.
상품 주소(slug)를 한 줄에 하나씩. 비우면 함께 구매한 상품이 자동: One product slug per line. Empty = frequently-bought-together items are shown automatically.
상품을 등록하고 가격·재고·진열 상태를 관리합니다. 금액은 원 단위입니다: Register products and manage price, stock, and visibility. Amounts are in KRW.
상품을 묶어 보여주는 진열입니다. 주소는 /shop/event/<slug: A curated product showcase. Its URL is /shop/event/<slug>, and it appears in the menu link picker. With a date range set, it drops out of listings when it ends, and opening it directly shows an 'ended' notice.
Shown to customers and used as the product name in sales reports.
Customers see this on the bill. Say what the charge is for.
엑셀에서 머리글을 포함해 복사한 뒤 붙여넣으세요. 주소(slug)와 상품: Copy from your spreadsheet including the header row and paste it here. Slug and name are required; an existing slug is updated. Write the category by name. Once paid, an order is created automatically and included in sales and tax records. To change the amount, cancel and re-bill — changing a figure the customer already saw invites disputes.
접수·입금 확인·발송·취소·환불을 주문서에 적힌 주소로 알립니다. 비회원: Notifies the address on the order for placement, payment, shipping, cancellation and refunds. Guests also get an order lookup link.

제주·도서산간 추가 배송비를 우편번호 구간으로 정합니다. 주소 문자열이: Set remote-area surcharges (Jeju, islands) by ZIP code ranges. Matching is by ZIP code, not address text — Seoul has a street named 'Jejudo-ro' too. When ranges overlap, the highest surcharge applies.
주기를 정하면 회원이 카드를 등록하고 정기배송을 신청할 수 있습니다. 청: With an interval set, members can register a card and subscribe. The billing amount is locked at signup time.
주문 상태를 변경하면 이력이 기록됩니다. 취소·환불로 바꾸면 재고가 자동: Status changes are recorded in the history. Changing to cancelled/refunded restores stock automatically.
Shown as-is on the order-complete screen and order lookup.
주문번호와 송장번호 (한 줄에 하나): Order number and tracking number (one per line)
최근 3개월 구매 실적(반품 제외)으로 등급이 자동 배정됩니다. 6시간마: Tiers are assigned automatically from the last 3 months of purchases (returns excluded). Recalculated every 6 hours; after creating or editing tiers, call 'Recalculate now'. The tier with a 0 KRW threshold is the default.
켜면 생일(월·일)을 등록한 회원의 쿠폰함에 생일날 자동 지급됩니다. 발: When on, the coupon is issued automatically on members' birthdays (month/day registered). Turns on 'Issued to members' as well. Each coupon issues once per member — create a new coupon each year for annual gifts.
켜면 쿠폰함에 지급받은 회원만 씁니다 — 코드가 커뮤니티에 퍼져도 대상이: When on, only members who were issued the coupon can use it — even if the code spreads online, the audience stays controlled. Issue via the API (/admin/coupons/:id/issue) after saving.
Paste the list from your carrier as-is; commas, tabs and spaces all work. Only the selected orders that appear in the list get a tracking number and move to in transit.
한 줄에 이미지 주소 하나. 최대 20장. 상세 화면에서 갤러리로 보여집: One image URL per line, up to 20. Shown as a gallery on the product page. If the main image is empty, the first line becomes the main image.
One per line: name|surcharge|stock (e.g. Color: Red|1000|10). Surcharge and stock are optional; empty stock means unlimited. Keeping a name unchanged preserves that option in existing carts.
How many products to show per page (4-60).

허용된 전이만 가능합니다. '처리완료'에서 재고 복원과 환불이 실행됩니다: Only allowed transitions are accepted. 'Completed' triggers stock restoration and the refund.
Issue on Hometax, enter the approval number, then set the status to 'Issued'.
회원의 정기배송 구독입니다. 금액·주기는 가입 시점에 고정되어 수정할 수: Members' recurring subscriptions. Amount and interval are locked at signup and can't be edited. Deleting means cancelling — future billing stops, but payment history and orders remain.
